paragraphs.text: Krav and Regna , known as the Unredeemed and the Redeemer respectively, are a demon and angel pair from the plane of Kylem .

Krav and Regna are partners and lovers who fight together in Valor's Reach on Kylem. Regna is a dark-skinned angel with long brown hair, white wings, a blue & white dress, and a large metal shield. She is left-handed. Krev is a large light blue-skinned red-eyed humanoid demon with multiple horns atop his head. Despite their differences, the two are always seen together and appear greatly in love.
As a placeholder name, Gavin Verhey typed the word "anger" backwards, and it was kept as Regna's name.
